tools.name: get_airport_lounges
tools.description: List every lounge at one airport by its 3-letter IATA code (e.g. 'LHR', 'SIN', 'JFK'), plus the airport's location and lounge count.

tools.name: get_lounge_details
tools.description: Look up one airport lounge by its Airport Lounge List slug (e.g. 'plaza-premium-lounge-sin-terminal-1'). Returns location, hours, amenities and who can get in.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Move the browser to another page on Airport Lounge List, e.g. '/lounges/<slug>', '/airports/<slug>', '/networks/priority-pass', '/amenities/showers', '/access/credit-cards' or '/compare'.

tools.name: search_lounges
tools.description: Search every airport lounge in the directory by name, airport, city, country or IATA code (e.g. 'Heathrow', 'Plaza Premium SIN', 'Centurion'). Returns a page of matches with airport, terminal, day-pass availability and a link to each lounge.
